scripts.build: yarn workspace @selfchecks/core build && yarn workspace @selfchecks/db build && yarn workspace @selfchecks/cli build && yarn workspace @selfchecks/worker build && yarn workspace @selfchecks/web build
scripts.checks:deploy:account: yarn workspace @selfchecks/cli dev deploy --project default --root $HOME/dev/account/config/checkly --config checkly.config.ts
scripts.checks:test:account: yarn workspace @selfchecks/cli dev test --project default --root $HOME/dev/account/config/checkly --check bff-health --record
scripts.checks:test:account:signin: yarn workspace @selfchecks/cli dev test --project default --root $HOME/dev/account/config/checkly --check Signin --record
scripts.prod:infra: yarn prod:infra:migrate && docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d
scripts.prod:infra:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.prod.yml up --force-recreate --abort-on-container-exit --exit-code-from migrate migrate
scripts.typecheck: yarn workspace @selfchecks/core typecheck && yarn workspace @selfchecks/db typecheck && yarn workspace @selfchecks/cli typecheck && yarn workspace @selfchecks/worker typecheck && yarn workspace @selfchecks/web typecheck
